title: Components of a specified diagonal Kummer boundary
statement: Let $N>0$, let $A$ be a finite commutative ring with $NA=0$, and let $S$ be an N-invertible scheme. Put $P=\mathbf P^1_S$ and $W=P\times_SP$ [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-fibre-product, def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. Suppose the diagonal ideal is invertible and $\kappa$ is its supported Kummer boundary [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal, lem-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer]. Let $c:A_{\mathbf P^1_P}\to A_{\mathbf P^1_P}(1)[2]$ satisfy the actual scalar Kummer Chern specification [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class]. For any normalized finite twist transport [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows] and either product projection $p$, let $J_p$ be the explicit canonical chart transport of its shifted-line direct image to the relative P1 direct image. Then there is a base class $\beta_p:A_P\to A_P(1)[2]$ with $\alpha_p Rp_*(\delta_\kappa)J_p=\beta_p u_P+h_c$, using the canonical pasted constant unit alpha [lem-amb-p1-diagonal-integrals] and the specified twisted unit and Chern adjunct [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows]. No splitting, trace or integral identity is assumed.

proof.text: Use the canonical derived Chern arrow defined by the inverse of the proved class bijection. Supported Chern normalization identifies the supported diagonal arrow with the canonical Chern arrow of the dual diagonal ideal. The Picard identity, normalized pullback naturality and additivity identify its chart transport with the sum of the base and relative Chern arrows; the given Chern specification identifies the relative arrow with c.

proof.text: Factor the original projected supported composite using functoriality and associativity. The chart transport is the fixed adjunction/composition/twist composite. Use the proved equations for the unchanged supported unit and its composition, then adjunction naturality, to identify the chart image with the adjunct of the pulled-back Chern arrow. Direct image is additive. Finally the proved equations identifying the published projective-line components with the recorded adjunction give the base and Chern summands.

theorem ordinaryFiniteP1_diagonal_kummer_component_formula (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (hP : IsUnit (N : Γ(ProjectiveLine S, ⊤)))
    (hPP : IsUnit (N : Γ(ProjectiveLine (ProjectiveLine S), ⊤)))
    (hW : IsUnit (N : Γ(pullback (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S), ⊤)))
    (c : ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine (ProjectiveLine S)) ⟶
      (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine (ProjectiveLine S)))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hc : ordinaryFiniteP1ChernSpec A N hA (ProjectiveLine S) hPP c)
    (hI : (pullback.diagonal (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).ker.IsInvertible)
    (κ : ordinaryFiniteSupportedExt A (pullback.diagonal (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S))
      (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine
        (pullback (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)) N A hA))
    (hκ : SupportedKummerBoundary A N hA (pullback.diagonal (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S))
      hI hW κ) :
    ∀ a : Bool, ∃ β : ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S) ⟶
              (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine S))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧,
            ordinaryFiniteP1DiagonalSupportedMap A N hA S a κ ≫
              ordinaryFiniteP1DiagonalChartMap A N hA t S hS a =
            β ≫ ordinaryFiniteP1Unit A N hA t (ProjectiveLine S) hP +
              ordinaryFiniteP1ChernPushforward A N hA (ProjectiveLine S) c
lean.note: F1 records the existing Ext group and supported realization on the named objects. The supported map retains the original alpha-then-realization composite through a definitionally equal wrapper. Its proof factors this composite through ordinaryFiniteSupportedArrow_pushforward. The supported-map and component-theorem kappa binders name the same Ext group; all other existing binders, conclusions and attributes are preserved. The chart-map body specializes ordinaryFiniteChartTransport, the same literal canonical adjunction/composition/shifted-line comparison composite constructed for arbitrary schemes. Z8 relocates this complete F1 construction and proof below the adjunction unit; FiniteP1DiagonalPicard imports the lower projection/chart interface to avoid the previous import cycle. The defining-equation conversion from cached Alpha to the same supported-unit pair is proved in ProjectiveLineDiagonalAlphaUnits and rewritten before the original factorization. This conversion changes none of the mathematical proof steps or dependencies. The statement dependency on the higher diagonal integrals is replaced by the lower canonical component construction, which now owns the target and maps; statement, proof and proof_deps remain main's.
